states: Private mock stack built from origin/main 43a80dafd9 plus this change, with a local-only go build -overlay of internal/mock/generator.go: host agents apollo-114 and meridian-731 held past their reporting lease (offline, LastSeen frozen 14 minutes back, readings retained); all four standalone agents seeded with md0 raid1 clean and md1 raid5 'clean, degraded, recovering' at 42.4% / 118M/sec (sdd1 faulty, sde1 spare rebuilding); analytics-batch-310 and analytics-batch-58 forced to report no Proxmox guest filesystems with diskStatusReason agent-not-running

Agents linked into VMs through the real POST /api/resources/{vm}/link: apollo-114 -> analytics-batch-118, meridian-731 -> analytics-batch-310 (both silent), spectrum-709 -> analytics-batch-262 and meridian-848 -> analytics-batch-58 (both live). /api/resources serves agent.stale true with the agent's raid, disks and networkInterfaces on the two silent VMs and no stale flag on the two live ones

Before this change (same stack, PR 2652 head, real browser run): silent VMs showed Guest RAID with emerald 'clean', amber 'clean, degraded, recovering', 'Rebuild: 42% · 118M/sec' and coloured member badges, network rows and 'Pulse 0.2.0-alpha' as current; the live analytics-batch-58 showed its agent filesystems as 'Usage unavailable · ?/328 GB' under 'Guest agent not running. Install and start qemu-guest-agent in the VM.'

After, silent analytics-batch-310 (agent filesystems) at 1440 and 390: Pulse Agent row 'Pulse 0.2.0-alpha · stopped reporting' in amber with title 'Pulse Agent 0.2.0-alpha has stopped reporting. Its readings here are its last report.'; Filesystems status 'Using last known disk stats. The Pulse Agent in this guest stopped reporting.' with 'Last known 75%' / 'Last known 42%' rows and no bars; Network status 'Using last known interface details. The Pulse Agent in this guest stopped reporting.' over a muted eth0 row; both RAID arrays data-raid-reading=last-known, '(last known)' states in muted text titled 'Last known reading, not current: host agent stopped reporting', 'Rebuild was at 42%', neutral badges 'sdd1 · faulty' and 'sde1 · spare rebuilding'

After, silent analytics-batch-118 with Proxmox guest filesystems (earlier run of the same change): RAID, network and agent row read as above while the Proxmox filesystem rows kept their usage and bars

After, live analytics-batch-58 (agent filesystems, Proxmox agent-not-running): '/ 65%' and '/data 28%' with progress bars, no status line, no qemu-guest-agent advice; RAID current with emerald/amber states and 'Rebuild: 42% · 118M/sec'
After, live control analytics-batch-262 (Proxmox filesystems): unchanged at both widths

No horizontal page overflow at either width; no page errors. Stopped guests were not exercised in the browser: their agent filesystems read 'Usage unavailable' under the stopped-VM message whether the guest status or the Proxmox vm-stopped reason says stopped, and the stale flip on an open drawer, are covered by GuestDrawer.test.tsx. The final stopped-status gate changes only stopped guests, so the running-guest states above were observed on this code path
interactions: Opened each guest's inline drawer from the Proxmox workloads table filtered by name (name cell click at 1440, first visible cell tap at 390)
Scrolled the phone drawer to the Network section and Guest RAID card and captured both
Read computed text colour, titles and data-raid-reading of every Filesystems, Network, System and RAID row via Playwright
